properties.displayName: GO-PRD-SENTINEL-034 Suspicious downloads to URL contains 'wget'
properties.description: This Use Case is designed to enable the detection of unsafe and non-interactive download of files from the web with the help of wget utility.
properties.query:
let TriggeredIPs = SecurityAlert
| where DisplayName contains "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-034 Suspicious downloads to URL contains" 
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h) and TimeGenerated < ago(5m)
| extend A = parse_json(Entities) 
| mvexpand A
| extend IP = A.Address
| where isnotempty(IP)
| project IP;
let ceflogs = CommonSecurityLog1
| where TimeGenerated> ago(5m)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
|where DeviceVendor == "Forcepoint"  or DeviceVendor == "Palo Alto Networks" or DeviceVendor == "McAfee"
| where RequestClientApplication has "Wget" and DestinationHostName !has "paloaltonetworks.com" and DestinationHostName !has "oracle.com" and 
DestinationHostName !has "wdc.com" and DestinationHostName !has "virusshare.com" and DestinationHostName !has "splunk.com"
| extend URLCustomEntity = RequestURL
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP
| extend AccountCustomEntity = SourceUserName;
let pasyslog = paloaltologs 
| where TimeGenerated> ago(5m)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where ThreatType == "url"
| where UserAgent has "Wget" and RequestURL !has "paloaltonetworks.com" and RequestURL !has "oracle.com" and 
RequestURL !has "wdc.com" and RequestURL !has "virusshare.com" and RequestURL !has "splunk.com"
| extend URLCustomEntity = RequestURL
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP
| extend AccountCustomEntity = SourceUserName;
let bclogs = bluecoat
| where TimeGenerated> ago(5m)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where UserAgent has "Wget" and RequestURL !has "paloaltonetworks.com" and RequestURL !has "oracle.com" and 
RequestURL !has "wdc.com" and RequestURL !has "virusshare.com" and RequestURL !has "splunk.com"
| extend URLCustomEntity = RequestURL
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP;
let ciscowsalogs = CiscoWSA
| where TimeGenerated> ago(5m)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where UserAgent has "Wget" and RequestURL !has "paloaltonetworks.com" and RequestURL !has "oracle.com" and RequestURL !has "wdc.com" and RequestURL !has "virusshare.com" and RequestURL !has "splunk.com"
| extend URLCustomEntity = RequestURL
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP;
let websenselogs = Websense
| where TimeGenerated> ago(5m)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where UserAgent has "Wget" and RequestURL !has "paloaltonetworks.com" and RequestURL !has "oracle.com" and RequestURL !has "wdc.com" and RequestURL !has "virusshare.com" and RequestURL !has "splunk.com"
| extend URLCustomEntity = RequestURL
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP;
let squidlogs = SquidPrxy
| where TimeGenerated> ago(5m)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where UserAgent has "Wget" and RequestURL !has "paloaltonetworks.com" and RequestURL !has "oracle.com" and RequestURL !has "wdc.com" and RequestURL !has "virusshare.com" and RequestURL !has "splunk.com"
| extend URLCustomEntity = RequestURL
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP;
let alllogs=union pasyslog, ceflogs, bclogs, ciscowsalogs,websenselogs,squidlogs;
alllogs
